auditory_strength.instruction: Estimate the mean human rating of how strongly the meaning of this English word is experienced through hearing. The scale ranges from 0 (not experienced at all) to 5 (experienced greatly).
auditory_strength.field_description: word is the original English word or expression, without sentence context. Ratings summarize people's experience of its meaning across possible senses; they are not a measurement of a physical property.
